images_passed_as: upload:<id> references (POST https://api.pixellab.ai/v2/uploads) or the no-auth PixelLab CDN URLs of earlier results; no inline base64 anywhere
seed: 1234 on every call that takes one (create_image_pro, create_character_state, transfer_outfit, create_portrait_character). create_character and animate_character take none. No retakes, so 1235 was never used.
description_rule: Part A descriptions are Job 1 (c) create_image_pro descriptions verbatim; they already end with the STYLE sentence (and the NPC ones with 'Facing the viewer, standing.'), so nothing more was appended. NPC rotations reuse Job 1's create_character description.

unsplit.how: balance 1718.90 after Part A Pro, 1649.90 with every job but transfer_outfit done: 69 = 3 rotations + 26 animations + these 40. They ran concurrently, so the split is not measured. Quotes: state ~10-25, each portrait ~15 (doc: 10 and 15), which points to 10 + 15 + 15.

retakes: none (every Part A item had at least one whole candidate; nothing in Part B hit a hard failure)
rejected_calls_not_charged: 3 uploads refused: the 15-minute upload URL had expired; a new one was fetched

arguments.description: Old Kesh, a Kindled hermit and fisherman: a small figure made of river-dark brown-black clay, about 40 px tall, with a few widely spaced amber freckles like small lights, long white hair and a white beard, a patched grey-ochre sailcloth tunic with a wet grey patch, dark trousers and wrapped dark feet. He holds a long wooden casting rod upright at his side. Top-down RPG pixel art seen from a low three-quarter view, light from the top left, a 1 px dark navy-violet outline, two or three shades per material, no dithering, transparent background, no text or letters. Facing the viewer, standing.
